product: NASA-SSH Simple Gridded Sea Surface Height from Standardized Reference Missions Only Version 1.1
gridding_method: Gridded using pyresample resample_gauss with roi=600000.0, sigma=175000.0, neighbours=500, respecting basin boundaries as defined by the basin mask ID numbers and their connections.
method: cos-latitude weighted global mean of ssha per grid over the cells that carry a value, metres to mm; months as the mean of their grids
gia: linear +0.3 mm per year added, referenced to 2005-01 (Peltier 2004; the correction the 2018 WCRP budget applies to altimetric global mean sea level)
uncertainty_basis: stated noise floor: standard deviation of adjacent-month differences of the finished series divided by sqrt(2); the product ships no error field
